categories_thin: Independent hotels/inns: none found - the only inn-like listings in town (Metuchen Inn, Brown Stone) are restaurants, which are excluded

Security-system installers: only out-of-town service-area pages (Certified Protection in Edison, BGS Security, Absolute Protective Systems) plus Lock Sharp US and Sterling Key & Lock Works; no Metuchen-based alarm installer surfaced
Garage doors: only service-area/lead-generation sites (ez2fixllc.com with a Metuchen 'location' page, garagedoorrepairmetuchennj.com) whose local presence I could not confirm - none added
Pools: only service-area companies based outside Metuchen (The Pool Place in Avenel, Lampsi Pools, Pool Bros NJ) - none based in town, none added

Towing: Metuchen's tow operations appear mainly as service-area or lead-generation sites (metuchentowing.us) plus the auto shops already listed; no independent Metuchen tow yard with a verified address was confirmed
Manufacturing and wholesale: 17 addresses, but almost all come from one bulk directory with no website or phone, so verification will be heavy
Masonry/concrete: only two directory-only names found (Chris Thorne Masonry, AJA Masonry Corp); most other results were out-of-town or Angi service-area listings
Lumber/building supply and garden centres: only Boro Ace Hardware; nearby Sherwin-Williams and Home Depot are chains and excluded
Locksmiths: three names total (Lock Sharp US, Sterling Key & Lock Works, plus the disputed First Choice entry); most 'Metuchen locksmith' results are national lead-generation sites
